Abhishek Banerjee questioned for six hours in billboard case

Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee was questioned for over six hours by Kolkata Police on Wednesday regarding a Camac Street billboard. He arrived at the Shakespeare Sarani police station around 11:30 am and was interrogated by police sources. Banerjee stated that the BJP is vindictive and afraid of the TMC.
